description: This file implements a translator for converting between in-tree Cinder volume specifications and CSI volume specifications in Kubernetes, including methods for translating storage classes, inline volumes, and persistent volumes, as well as support checks and plugin name retrieval.

classes.name: osCinderCSITranslator
classes.description: A struct that handles translation between in-tree Cinder and CSI Cinder volume specifications.

methods.name: TranslateInTreeStorageClassToCSI
methods.description: Converts an in-tree Cinder StorageClass to a CSI StorageClass, translating parameters and allowed topologies.

methods.name: TranslateInTreeInlineVolumeToCSI
methods.description: Converts an in-tree Cinder volume to a CSI PersistentVolume.

methods.name: TranslateInTreePVToCSI
methods.description: Converts an in-tree Cinder PersistentVolume to a CSI PersistentVolume.

methods.name: TranslateCSIPVToInTree
methods.description: Converts a CSI PersistentVolume back to an in-tree Cinder PersistentVolume.

methods.name: CanSupport
methods.description: Checks if the plugin supports a given persistent volume.

methods.name: CanSupportInline
methods.description: Checks if the plugin supports a given inline volume.

methods.name: GetInTreePluginName
methods.description: Returns the name of the in-tree plugin driver.

methods.name: GetCSIPluginName
methods.description: Returns the name of the CSI plugin.

methods.name: RepairVolumeHandle
methods.description: Repairs or returns the volume handle, currently a no-op.
